name: Content Automation Shell - Repurpose and Schedule

parameters.content:
## Content Automation Shell
Replace each placeholder (NoOp) node below with real nodes as you build this out:

1. Fetch Source Content -> an RSS Feed / Google Sheets / Notion node pulling from your content calendar or blog
2. Repurpose Content -> a Code / OpenAI node that reformats the piece into a tweet thread, LinkedIn post, etc.
3. Schedule & Publish -> a Buffer / social platform node (or a Set node queuing it for manual review)

The Schedule Trigger is OFF by default (workflow is inactive) so it's safe to import and edit.

nodes.name: 1. Fetch Source Content
nodes.notes: Replace with a node that pulls the next piece of content due to be repurposed (blog RSS, content calendar sheet, Notion database, etc.).

nodes.name: 2. Repurpose Content
nodes.notes: Replace with a Code or AI node that reformats the source content into the target format (tweet thread, LinkedIn post, newsletter blurb, etc.).

nodes.name: 3. Schedule and Publish
nodes.notes: Replace with the node that queues or publishes the repurposed content (Buffer, a social platform's API, or a Set node for manual review).
